g.text: A listing's address, and the links to it (REQ-005-6/10)
Before approval a listing has no public address.
An Admin approves a listing (REQ-004-5)
Make the slug from the title as it is now:
lowercase letters, digits and hyphens,
at most 60 characters ("job" if nothing is left)
Add the next free number: "barista-2"
yes
Does any listing have, or did any listing
ever have, that address in this region?
no
The public address is now
/jobs/<region slug>/<listing slug>
(never the listing's id)
and the listing is on the public lists
The Admin owns the listing?
yes
no
No email (REQ-004-9)
"Your listing is published" email to the owner, with a link
to the public page and a link to it in My listings
While it is Published, the owner view (003) and the
Admin view (004) each show "See the public page"
On the public page, the owner sees "This is your listing."
with "Manage this listing" (if they can still open
My listings). An Admin sees "Open the Admin view".
An Admin who owns it sees both. Nobody else sees either
What happens to the listing later?
The address stays exactly as it was
The address changes to the new region
(same slug, or the next free number there.
Moved back: the address it had there before).
The old address forwards to the new one
The address stays as it was
(a region's slug never changes, spec 002)
Still Published?
yes
The address stays the listing's own and is never
given to another listing. It now shows
"This job is no longer listed." (REQ-005-7),
with the same links for the owner and for Admins
title or business
name is edited
its region is renamed
or hidden
an Admin moves it
to another region
no, closed or taken down
